title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content: The official website for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga presented a new trailer on Thursday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "Moonlit" by Naniwa Danshi .
author: ANN

title: Renowned One Piece Animator Teases a Major Plan For The Best Flashback Ever
content: For a series as popular as One Piece , the fan base is massive, and they often spot trolls who post bait or slander about anything related to the show. The term “overanimation” is often thrown around as rage bait about an anime show or an episode that’s well-animated.
author: ComicBook

title: Studio Ghibli’s New Short Film Gets a Major Update
content: Even decades after its establishment in 1985, Studio Ghibli has remained the most iconic animation studio when it comes to anime movies. Every film produced by the studio is loved for its striking visuals, rich storytelling, and deep emotional impact.
author: ComicBook

title: 'You, Fireworks, and Our Promise' Anime Film's Video Previews Theme Song
content: The staff for the anime film of Kaori Mado 's You, Fireworks, and Our Promise ( Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to or Kimi-Hana for short) novel series began streaming a "theme song mashup" promotional video for the film on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Every Jujutsu Kaisen Character Who Could Defeat Gojo Satoru, Ranked
content: Jujutsu Kaisen emerged as a series with one of the most interesting power systems and introduced Gojo Satoru, who is widely regarded as not just the strongest character in the series, but also one of the strongest anime characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Star Wars: Visions' 'Black' Short Nominated for Emmy for Animated Program
content: The Television Academy's 78th annual Primetime Emmy Awards nominated Shinya Ōhira and david production 's "Black" short from the Star Wars: Visions anthology project in the Outstanding Animated Program category on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Mario Kart Tour Game Ends Service on September 29
content: The official English X (formerly Twitter ) account for Nintendo 's Mario Kart Tour game announced on Wednesday that the game will end on September 29 at 11:00 p.m. PDT (September 30 at 2:00 a.m. EDT).
author: ANN

title: 4 Underrated Saturday Morning Cartoons From 1995 That Only ’90s Kids Even Remember
content: A few major things happened in the 1990s that made the decade one of the best for animation. The first is that Nickelodeon finally started investing in its own original programming that wasn’t just live-action, giving the world the first Nicktoons that would become a staple of its programming.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Post-Credits Scene Hints at Franchise’s Future
content: After over a decade, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 has finally released its final DLC pack, “ Future Saga Chapter 4 .” On top of giving the Time Patrol their final confrontation with the villainous mad scientist Fuu, it also gave Son Goku a new transformation to add to his repertoire.
author: ComicBook

title: Final Fantasy VII Ever Crisis Game Ends Service on October 6
content: In a Producer's Letter released also on Wednesday, game producer Shoichi Ichikawa explained that it was hard to find an ideal balance between visual quality and development costs, while also maintaining gameplay balance. The game launched for iOS and Android devices in September 2023.
author: ANN
